principle: A review item is gated by its demonstrated scientific effect, never by the mere existence of an open item on the same PDB. The forbidden rule is: 'if any open review item touches an analysis unit, exclude the whole unit.'
narrowest_scope_rule: Exclusion is applied at the narrowest level that removes the unreliable identity. An unresolved ligand in a PDB never removes a separate, reliable ligand observation in the same PDB.
unit_removal_rule: A unit is removed from public-beta pooled analysis only when its eligible structure-slot denominator becomes zero. Otherwise the blocked slots are removed and the unit metric is re-derived from the remaining eligible slots.
zero_denominator_rule: A zero denominator yields NA (not_estimable). Never 0%.

rules.test: site_class_remediation.enters_pooled_aggregation is false for the ligand entity
rules.reason: An unresolved binding-site class is an aggregation-identity blocker under rule A. Where Phase 4 already kept the entity out of the site-class pooled aggregate, the exclusion exists and must not be counted a second time.

rules.test: the PDB contributes no observation to any aggregation unit
rules.reason: Unresolved apo versus ligand-bound status is a blocker only where a ligand-contact row exists. A confirmed apo structure with no contact row is already excluded.

rules.test: the receptor instance is in the Phase 4 mapping_unresolved_excluded_from_generic_aggregation set
rules.reason: Phase 4 already excludes unvalidated mapping routes from generic aggregation. Re-excluding is double counting.

rules.test: the PDB contributes at least one observation to an aggregation unit
rules.reason: Unresolved receptor identity or receptor mapping changes which receptor the contacts belong to, so every structure slot of that PDB is unreliable.

rules.test: the ligand entity appears as the ligand of an observation in an aggregation unit
rules.reason: Unresolved ligand identity is a blocker for the observation it names, and only for that observation. A different ligand in the same PDB is unaffected.

rules.test: the polymer entity is itself the ligand of an observation in an aggregation unit
rules.reason: Rule A blocks an unresolved polymer-chain role only when the chain is treated as a ligand. Where the chain is a tag, fusion or transducer construct, resolving it can ADD a missing polymer-interface observation but cannot invalidate an existing small-molecule observation. That is an under-inclusion risk, recorded as a warning rather than removing sound data.

rules.test: the unit's normalized structural state was derived from transducer presence
rules.reason: Rule C: a transducer disagreement is warning-only where the aggregate is not transducer-stratified. Units are stratified by normalized structural state; the disagreement matters only where that state was derived from transducer presence.

rules.test: the tethered-ligand question is unresolved AND the PDB contributes an observation whose site class is a pocket class
rules.reason: For a receptor whose endogenous ligand is a tethered segment, whether a co-bound small molecule occupies the orthosteric pocket is undecidable until the tethered ligand is resolved. That is an unresolved binding-site classification under rule A, so the observation is excluded rather than presented as a settled pocket contact.
An annotated component absent from coordinates has no contact row to exclude.

rules.test: the component appears as the ligand of an observation in an aggregation unit
rules.reason: A component absent from coordinates contributes no contact row.

rules.test: the unresolved residues intersect the contacted or motif residues of an observation
rules.reason: Rule C: a mutation metadata issue outside contacted or motif residues does not change a pooled contact metric.
A regression crosswalk discrepancy is a reconciliation record against the frozen aminergic project, not a defect in the current observation's identity.

never_auto_excluded: Metadata-only review items remain visible and never automatically remove otherwise eligible data.
policy_wording_constraint: The public wording is 'open items visible and excluded from pooled analyses where required'. It must never be widened to 'all open items are excluded'.
